referenceSource.title: ICPC contest archive — Kattis judge index
referenceSource.scope: Third-party contest/problem metadata index; it states Kattis problem URLs use /problems/{id} and associates problem IDs with contest sources.
referenceSource.limitation: This index is not the official Kattis statement itself. A matching row confirms only the title/slug/contest metadata association, not statement contents, constraints, or long-scenario qualification.

gateDecision: Keep all 41 as candidate-only. Do not promote any record based on this metadata index alone. Resolve the exactchange2/exactchange3 slug conflict. For unmatched entries, obtain official Kattis statements or authoritative contest statements and verify title, scenario, input, output, constraints, and canonical URL.
